subject: Customer advocate recording — scope, schedule, and release paperwork
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ella Ramirez <ella@novacare.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-18T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Customer advocate recording — scope, schedule, and release paperwork

Hi Ella —

Thanks again for agreeing to chat about NovaCare’s deployment of Redwood Inference. We’d love to record a short (2–3 minute) on-camera segment with you as a customer advocate that highlights the impact on latency/cost and the team-level outcomes you’ve seen. High-level plan: 

- Format: remote Zoom-recorded interview (BrightFrame Media will handle capture + live switching).
- Length: ~15–20 minute session to produce a 2–3 minute edited clip + 30s social cuts.
- Topics: business problem, why you chose Redwood, concrete outcomes (latency, cost reductions, reliability), and one piece of advice for teams adopting LLMs.
- Assets: short script outline, talking points, and a standard release form (attached).

Proposed windows (Pacific time):
- Wed Sep 2, 9:00–11:00am PT (preferred)
- Fri Sep 4, 12:00–2:00pm PT

Can you confirm interest and whether remote recording works for you? If yes, we’ll send a DocuSign release to your legal contact and a one-page prep sheet. Also note we’ll provide a $250 honorarium (vendor reimbursement) for your time and include written signoff on final cuts before anything is published.

Attachments: draft-script-novacare-v1.docx, release-form-template.pdf, call-sheet-remote.md

Appreciate it — excited to feature NovaCare.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0191

Subject: Re: Customer advocate recording — scope, schedule, and release paperwork

Thanks Sean — thrilled to help. Remote works fine for us. Quick Qs from my side: 

1) Our legal team typically wants to review any release before signature — who should I loop in?
2) Could we push to the afternoon slot on Sep 2? I have a board meeting in the morning.
3) I’d like to see the final questions you’ll ask so I can prep a few metrics.

Also — is it possible to have someone on the call to capture a few screenshots of the dashboard for B-roll (we’d prefer those to be internal screenshots, not Redwood assets)?

If you can confirm legal and send the interview questions, I’ll run this by Tom in legal and confirm availability.

Best,
Ella Ramirez
VP Product, NovaCare Health
ella@novacare.com
+1 206-555-4420

Hi Ella —

Great — thank you. Quick notes from the production side (BrightFrame Media is on cc of this thread):

- Interview questions (short):
  1) Brief intro — role and use case (30s)
  2) Challenge before Redwood (30–45s)
  3) What changed after adoption — specific metrics (latency, cost, error rate) (45–60s)
  4) How this shifted developer/product workflows (30–45s)
  5) One piece of advice for other teams (15–20s)

- Remote capture: we’ll ask you to join a Zoom link where BrightFrame records separate audio + video tracks. We can also take a screen-share window for B-roll; if you prefer NovaCare to supply screenshots, that’s fine — we’ll only use what you authorize.
- Release: attached is a standard media release (release-form-template.pdf). We can send it to Tom at NovaCare via DocuSign for signature; the document is intentionally simple (publication rights + right to edit), and we’ll confirm final rights with you in writing.
- Honorarium: $250 via corporate gift card or ACH — let us know preference.

If Sep 2 afternoon is good, we’ll tentatively hold 1:00pm PT. Monica, can you coordinate the calendar invite and the DocuSign send? Sean, please confirm HubSpot deal link and we’ll attach the asset to the record.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: release-form-template.pdf, draft-script-novacare-v1.docx

From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@novacare.com>

Date: 2026-08-20T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Customer advocate recording — scope, schedule, and release paperwork

Hi all —

Thanks, Ella — I’m the counsel who handles marketing releases. Please send the release to me (pdf or DocuSign is fine). A couple of notes from NovaCare legal: 

- We generally require a 30-day review window for any edits to quotes used as substantive claims (we don’t expect to exercise that here, but flagging).
- Please include a clause that allows NovaCare to request removal of the asset if it contains inaccurate performance numbers tied to our platform configurations.

We’re happy to sign once we confirm those two items. Also, how is Redwood handling any customer data contained in B-roll screenshots? We need confirmation that no PHI or patient identifiers will be captured.

Tom Ellis
General Counsel, NovaCare Health
tom.ellis@novacare.com

All — quick status and next steps (internal owners in parens):

1) Schedule: Ella is good for Wed Sep 2 at 1:00pm PT — Monica, please send the calendar invite with Zoom link and BrightFrame dial-in (owner: monica_patel).
2) Release: Marissa to update release with the two legal notes Tom requested (30-day review window + removal clause for inaccurate performance claims) then send via DocuSign to Tom (owner: marissa_cole). DocuSign link to use: https://www.docusign.net/s/sample-ds-link
3) B-roll / PHI: Nora (BrightFrame) — confirm in writing that production will only record screen snippets provided by NovaCare and that no PHI will be captured. We will require explicit written confirmation for Tom.
4) Assets: I’ve attached the draft script and call sheet for production. We’ll ask Ella to review the five short questions and give a preferred metric to call out.
5) Compensation: $250 honorarium — Sean will confirm payment method with Ella (owner: sean_gallagher).

Next steps: Monica to send invites and DocuSign goes out by end of day tomorrow. Marissa — once you update the release, cc me and Tom so we have legal on the record.

Thanks — team, let’s keep this tight; marketing deadline for the edited asset is Sep 30.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
